name: DniproHES
significance: First major Dnipro dam. Its reservoir submerged the Dnipro Rapids and enabled through navigation.

name: Kakhovka HPP
significance: Created the Kakhovka Reservoir, inundating much of the lower-Dnipro floodplain and Velykyi Luh. The dam was destroyed in 2023, outside this timeline.

name: Kremenchuk HPP
significance: Created the largest Dnipro cascade reservoir by surface area.

name: Middle Dnipro HPP
significance: Added the Kamianske reservoir and another step to the cascade.

name: Kyiv HPP
significance: Created the Kyiv Reservoir upstream of the capital.

name: Kaniv HPP
significance: Last of the six main Dnipro cascade stations to begin generating; its final unit came online in 1975.
